description: This Java class defines a REST API resource for managing Provisioning Criteria within the Apache Fineract project. It includes endpoints for retrieving templates, individual criteria, all criteria, and for creating, updating, or deleting provisioning criteria. The class leverages JAX-RS annotations for RESTful endpoints, Swagger annotations for API documentation, and integrates with Fineract's security, command, and serialization services.

classes.name: ProvisioningCriteriaApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class providing endpoints for managing provisioning criteria in the system.

methods.name: retrieveProvisioningCriteria
methods.description: Retrieves a specific provisioning criteria by ID, optionally returning a template if requested.

methods.name: createProvisioningCriteria
methods.description: Creates a new provisioning criteria based on received JSON payload.

methods.name: updateProvisioningCriteria
methods.description: Updates an existing provisioning criteria identified by ID.

methods.name: deleteProvisioningCriteria
methods.description: Deletes a provisioning criteria identified by ID.
